semantic_review: SearchMan Internet7 is not earlier Internet2; NapalmMan UnderInternet2 is not normal Internet2. Unspecified time limits remain unspecified; both require all viruses and any plugout means failure.
MetalMan and WindMan test the operator by operating the speaker, not fighting their own Navi. Fist tremble and admiration keep separate source metaphors; no imagined puzzle instructions added.
NumberMan academic test is source がくりょく candidate 학력; not a graduation credential gate. Functional wording and consistency require human review.
IceMan success promises passage after extermination and failure refuses; polite childlike source voice inherits the earlier candidate but hard=true remains separately tracked.
NapalmMan retry14 options have visible portrait; they are player choices, not lines spoken by him. Script12 reminder omits lending-program line as source does; no borrowed command/reward inserted.
